name: Sakura Relaxation ~Yon Shimai to no Love Love Doukyo Seikatsu~
original_name: さくらリラクゼーション～四姉妹とのラブラブ同居性活～
source:
Main character masters skills of chiropractor from his father, but lacks actual experience, so he enters a clinic. He is greeted by four Sakura family sisters and grandfather director who wishes to resign already. Protagonist is offered director position while living with four girls. Can he even fulfill his duties properly in this situation?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公从父亲那里学会整脊技术，却缺少实际经验，于是进入一家诊所工作。迎接他的是樱家4姐妹，以及已经想退休的祖父院长。主人公被邀请接任院长，并与4名女孩同住。在这种环境下，他真的能妥善履行职责吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
